messages.subject: Successfully assigned reads : 0
parts:
Hello - I am new to Subread, and have been unable to get any of my reads to map.  


These are not paired reads, they range in length from 11 to 48bp.  There is just one chromosome, this is bacterial data.


Input: $ featureCounts -T 5 -M -O -f -F SAF --fraction -a NC_007795.saf -o 54_Subread 54_Reads.sam


Any ideas on what to try next would be appreciated!!


- Alicia

Hi Alicia,

The problem is that the chromosome names in your annotation do not match those in your sam file. You may provide an alias name file via the '-A' option to solve it or you can modify your annotation file.

Cheers,
Wei
